description: Cross-engine contract for scripted-transcript validation messages. Each case runs the transcript schema validator first; when that passes and a modelID is given, the family chat-template constraint validator runs. `expect` is the EXACT first violation message (null = valid). Both engines' tests replay every case: Swift ExperimentTasks.transcriptSchemaViolation / transcriptFamilyViolation (Tests/ExperimentKitTests/TranscriptStudyTests.swift), Python prompt_render.transcript_schema_violation / transcript_family_violation (Server/tests/test_transcript_study.py). A message change must land in BOTH engines and in this file, consciously.

cases.name: empty-transcript
cases.expect: item 'v-empty': transcript is empty — a scripted transcript needs at least a final user turn

cases.name: unknown-role
cases.expect: item 'v-role': transcript turn 1 has role 'tool' — allowed roles are system, user, assistant

cases.name: empty-content
cases.expect: item 'v-content': transcript turn 2 has empty content

cases.name: system-not-first
cases.expect: item 'v-system': transcript may carry at most one system turn, and it must be first

cases.name: two-system-turns
cases.expect: item 'v-two-system': transcript may carry at most one system turn, and it must be first

cases.name: trailing-assistant
cases.expect: item 'v-prefill': transcript ends with an assistant turn — generation produces the assistant's reply to a final user turn; assistant-prefix continuation is out of scope for scripted-transcript studies (v1)

cases.name: system-only
cases.expect: item 'v-system-only': transcript must end with a user turn (generation produces the assistant's reply to it)

cases.name: gemma-assistant-first

transcript.content: I have already reviewed the record.

cases.expect: item 'v-gemma-lead': gemma-3's chat template requires the conversation to start with a user turn — this transcript starts with an assistant turn

cases.name: gemma-consecutive-user
cases.expect: item 'v-gemma-alt': gemma-3's chat template requires strict user/assistant alternation — transcript turns 2 and 3 are consecutive user turns

transcript.content: I have already reviewed the record.
You answer questions about your own prior statements.
Name a color, and nothing else.
I would rather not name a color.
Did you just refuse? Answer yes or no.
